records.text: Absorbing Man’s Omni-Morph Forms last 40% longer.

When Absorbing Man consumes Morph Charges, he gains a non-stacking Regeneration Passive, healing 30.01% of his missing Health over 12 seconds. As a Defender, this effect also triggers whenever Absorbing Man enters or refreshes any Form.
Personal Regeneration effects pause for 3 seconds when Absorbing Man is struck with True Damage and are removed when a form is deactivated early.

records.text: A fluid molecular structure grants Absorbing Man 20% Crit Resistance and Immunity to Armor Break and Armor Shattered Debuffs, but reduces his Critical Penetration by 20% flat.
Absorbing Man is no stranger to brawling with beings of otherworldly resilience. He reduces the duration of his Opponent’s Indestructible, Immortality, Unstoppable, and Unblockable Buffs by 90%.
Absorbing Man’s Special Attacks transform him into powerful altered Forms. He can only be in one Form at a time, and Form changes cannot fail due to Ability Accuracy Modification.
Absorbing Man starts each fight in his Black Uru Form by default, but can use the Pre-Fight Menu to change this default, which persists until changed again.
Being struck by a Heavy Attack while recovering from a Special Attack deactivates the current Form, which cannot be deactivated again in this way for 20 seconds.
Whenever a Buff ends on the Opponent or Absorbing Man is Immune to a Debuff, the current Form pauses for 3 seconds.
Interrupting an Opponent's Basic Attack with a Light Attack pauses the current Form for 6 seconds and inflicts a 485.29 potency Vulnerability Passive for 15 seconds. Max Stacks: 5.
If Absorbing Man would enter a Form that is already active, he instead Refines the Form, refreshing its duration and granting additional benefits.
Personal bursts of damage benefit from 300% of Absorbing Man's Critical Damage Multiplier when he lands a Critical Hit and cannot have their Ability Accuracy modified.
Special Attacks are Passively Unblockable.
Blocking a Hit reduces the Opponent’s Ability Power Rate by 72% until Absorbing Man stops blocking. The Power denied is transferred to Absorbing Man.
When Absorbing Man refreshes or changes Forms, he gains Morph Charges equal to the remaining percentage of his previous Form’s base duration. Max 600.
Whenever Absorbing Man is Immune to an Armor Break or Armor Shattered Debuff, he gains 90 Morph Charges.

Performing a Medium, Light, Medium Combo with at least 150 Morph Charges, or activating a Special Attack at max charges consumes available Charges to Refine the current Form and inflict one 30 second Vulnerability Passive with 2,750 potency for every 150 Charges consumed.
This attack gains 2,250 Critical Rating if the Opponent is Stunned as the first hit lands.
This attack instead gains 24,749.99 Critical Rating if the Opponent is not Stunned as the first hit lands.
Activating a Special Attack after the first hit lands applies this bonus Critical Rating to the entire Special and grants 30 Morph Charges.
Gain Immunity to all Bleed and Shock effects and +11,000 Physical Resistance.
All attacks deal a burst of 2,014.2 Physical Damage.
Refined: Absorbing Man can perform Critical Hits and trigger personal bursts of damage through the Opponent’s Block.
Gain Immunity to all Incinerate, Coldsnap, and Frostbite effects and +11,000 Energy Resistance.
All attacks deal Energy Damage instead of Physical, as well as a burst of 2,014.2 Energy Damage.
Refined: Contact with the Opponent inflicts an Incinerate Passive, dealing 3,524.85 Energy Damage over 1 second.

records.text: A fluid molecular structure grants Absorbing Man 20% Crit Resistance and Immunity to Armor Break and Armor Shattered Debuffs, but reduces his Critical Penetration by 20% flat.
Absorbing Man is no stranger to brawling with beings of otherworldly resilience. He reduces the duration of his Opponent’s Indestructible, Immortality, Unstoppable, and Unblockable Buffs by 90%.
Absorbing Man’s Special Attacks transform him into powerful altered Forms. He can only be in one Form at a time, and Form changes cannot fail due to Ability Accuracy Modification.
Absorbing Man starts each fight in his Black Uru Form by default, but can use the Pre-Fight Menu to change this default, which persists until changed again.
Being struck by a Heavy Attack while recovering from a Special Attack deactivates the current Form, which cannot be deactivated again in this way for 20 seconds.
Whenever a Buff ends on the Opponent or Absorbing Man is Immune to a Debuff, the current Form pauses for 3 seconds.
Interrupting an Opponent's Basic Attack with a Light Attack pauses the current Form for 6 seconds and inflicts a 485.29 potency Vulnerability Passive for 15 seconds. Max Stacks: 5.
If Absorbing Man would enter a Form that is already active, he instead Refines the Form, refreshing its duration and granting additional benefits.
Personal bursts of damage benefit from 300% of Absorbing Man's Critical Damage Multiplier when he lands a Critical Hit and cannot have their Ability Accuracy modified.
Special Attacks are Passively Unblockable.
Blocking a Hit reduces the Opponent’s Ability Power Rate by 72% until Absorbing Man stops blocking. The Power denied is transferred to Absorbing Man.
When Absorbing Man refreshes or changes Forms, he gains Morph Charges equal to the remaining percentage of his previous Form’s base duration. Max 600.
Whenever Absorbing Man is Immune to an Armor Break or Armor Shattered Debuff, he gains 90 Morph Charges.

Performing a Medium, Light, Medium Combo with at least 150 Morph Charges, or activating a Special Attack at max charges consumes available Charges to Refine the current Form and inflict one 30 second Vulnerability Passive with 2,750 potency for every 150 Charges consumed.
This attack gains 2,250 Critical Rating if the Opponent is Stunned as the first hit lands.
This attack instead gains 24,749.99 Critical Rating if the Opponent is not Stunned as the first hit lands.
Activating a Special Attack after the first hit lands applies this bonus Critical Rating to the entire Special and grants 30 Morph Charges.
Gain Immunity to all Bleed and Shock effects and +11,000 Physical Resistance.
All attacks deal a burst of 2,014.2 Physical Damage.
Refined: Absorbing Man can perform Critical Hits and trigger personal bursts of damage through the Opponent’s Block.
Gain Immunity to all Incinerate, Coldsnap, and Frostbite effects and +11,000 Energy Resistance.
All attacks deal Energy Damage instead of Physical, as well as a burst of 2,014.2 Energy Damage.
Refined: Contact with the Opponent inflicts an Incinerate Passive, dealing 3,524.85 Energy Damage over 1 second.

records.text: Kitty’s Light Attacks do not increase her Combo Meter, and she can trigger the Parry Mastery against non-contact attacks.
Against Mutants, Kitty’s advanced mastery of her mutation grants her Immunity to Delirium and Reversed Controls, and her Element Blasts, Phase, and Unblockable are unaffected by Ability Accuracy.
While holding Block as an Attacker, or any time as a Defender: Dashing while the Opponent has 3 or less unique Buffs grants a Phase Buff for 1.1 seconds.
While this Phase is active, Kitty can still perform Well-Timed Blocks. Phase pauses during her Dashes, Heavy Charges, Strikers, Specials, and when landing Basic Attacks as an Attacker.
This Phase grants +1,178.57 Energy Resistance, Stun and Neuroshock Immunity, prevents the damage taken from the Recoil Mastery, and increases the Opponent’s aggression.
While this Phase is active, Kitty’s second Medium, Heavy, and Special 2 are Passively Unblockable, and her Heavy releases instantly when charged.
If Kitty’s Phase triggers a Miss twice or a Stun Immunity once, when it ends it goes on cooldown for 20 seconds, plus 15 seconds for each time the cooldown has activated. Max: 50 seconds.
As a Defender, Kitty’s Phase always goes on cooldown when it ends, and it starts the fight on cooldown when fighting Cosmic Champions.
As an Attacker, releasing Kitty’s Heavy Attack ends Phase without triggering its cooldown, and all of her attacks and Well-Timed Blocks remove 1 second from its duration.
Kitty’s Phase cooldown expires 300% faster per Neuroshock on her, up to a max of 3.
Element Blast Passives are non-stacking, last 15 seconds, pause during all Specials, and 2 of them refresh on Kitty’s fourth Light.

Kitty’s second Medium inflicts an Element Blast based on the amount of Lights or Mediums performed in her current combo:•Fire: One Hit - 30% Suppression.•Air: Two Hits - 20% Power Reroute.•Water: Three Hits - 2,209.6 Battered.•Earth: Four Hits - 30% Cowardice.

articles.text: BiographyCarl Crusher Creel was an American professional Heavyweight boxer turned enforcer. While locked up in prison he was mutated using Asgardian magic by the trickster god Loki using a special potion. Creel then obtained the ability to absorb the properties of anything he touches and used his new-found power to break free from prison and soon became a villain for hire. He was later recruited into the Masters of Evil by Baron Zemo.
